description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Talcasoz Ithtirfen)
- Vendor B (Risanbel Yervokith)
- Vendor C (Kehesk Vahesk)
- Vendor D (Fensan Luwelans)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Talcasoz Ithtirfen):
  - Vendor A imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor A offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor A guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor A has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 5 months
Vendor B (Risanbel Yervokith):
  - Vendor B guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor B has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor B passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor B uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor B currently serves 67 hospital clients
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 365 thousand per year
Vendor C (Kehesk Vahesk):
  - Vendor C has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor C does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor C completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C keeps backups only on-site
  - Vendor C estimates deployment will take 4 months
Vendor D (Fensan Luwelans):
  - Vendor D keeps backups only on-site
  - Vendor D has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor D has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor D quoted a total cost of 671 thousand per year
  - Vendor D reported 8 major outages last year
